props.name: label
props.description: What sliding does — "Slide to pay $42.00". Also the slider's accessible name.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs once the thumb reaches the end. Return a promise to show pending until it settles.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Label while the promise is pending.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status, for when the confirmation is tracked elsewhere.

props.name: resetAfter
props.description: Milliseconds after done before the track resets. Leave it out to stay done.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Milliseconds Enter or Space must be held to confirm from the keyboard.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
